text: Terminate Paynova integration following INC-409 outage; standardize all European and US recurring subscriptions on Stripe Billing V2.

source.snippet: Decision by Priya Sharma on 2026-05-30: In light of INC-409 settlement failures, Northwind Labs reverses the March 1 decision and replaces Paynova with Stripe Billing V2 for all European recurring billing.
